svg.title: QVM Engine - Quality Value Momentum
svg.desc: Infographic explaining the QVM stock selection engine

g.text: Quantitative stock selection engine — 900 stocks → top 10 quarterly picks
Scan ~900 stocks through 7 fundamental filters. All must pass.
D/E <1 · Positive FCF · PEG <2 · FCF yield >1.5%
10 equal-weight positions (~10% each). Hold until next rebalance.
Only exit: 15% trailing stop from peak price. No replacement until rebalance.
Re-run ranking. Sell drops, buy new entries. Repeat.
